nodes.title: Align the accessible labels with the brief
nodes.summary: The SVG label currently reads "Rectangle: Width 30 mm, Height 20 mm", but the brief asked for wording like "Rectangle, 30 by 20 millimetres". Update the label text for each shape and confirm errors are announced.

nodes.title: Add component tests for the behaviour
nodes.summary: Only the geometry and validation functions are tested today. Add React Testing Library tests covering that switching shapes keeps each shape's values, that an invalid value hides the shape and shows the message, and that the defaults on first load are Circle at 20 mm.

nodes.title: Tidy the project setup
nodes.summary: Rename the package from shape-viewer to paper-cutout and replace the placeholder init.md with a README covering run, test and build, plus the design decisions. Add a .gitignore for node_modules and dist.

nodes.title: Record the resolved design decisions
nodes.summary: Write down that the triangle is equilateral and point up, and that the polygon is regular, sized by corner-to-corner diameter, and also point up. Document that the stroke is centred with the viewBox padded by half its width, and note that an odd-sided polygon is slightly shorter than its diameter.

nodes.title: Hook up the theme override (optional)
nodes.summary: The stylesheet supports data-theme="light" and "dark", but nothing sets it. Add a small light/dark/auto toggle, or remove the unused rules.
